module: Flowgraph node "Race Suspend" (tag scenario, no category defined). Suspends or resumes a race: flow on the suspend pin calls raceData:doSuspend(true), flow on resume calls doSuspend(false) (suspend takes priority). The flow output is always true.
notes: The three input pins flow, suspend and resume have the same description "Inflow for this node.".

work.desc: Suspends or resumes the race according to the suspend/resume pins.
